sources.title: Sample-Efficient Language Model for Hinglish Conversational AI
sources.snippet: Abstract This paper presents our process for developing a sample-efficient language model for a conversational Hinglish chatbot. Hinglish, a code-mixed language that combines Hindi and English, presents a unique computational challenge due to inconsistent spelling, lack of standardization, and limited quality of conversational data.

sources.title: AI voice generator for Indian languages | Sarvam
sources.snippet: Code-switching Indian creators speak in Hinglish, Tanglish, and Benglish naturally. A Hindi YouTube video switches to English for technical terms. A Tamil podcast uses English for business concepts. Sarvam handles code-switching natively because the model learned from real Indian speech patterns.
